description: 1-800-275-7415 Apple Spoofing Fake Tech Support Call 1-800-275-2273 1-855-638-5970 1-800-079-2158.  1-800-275-7415 Received call from this number which went to voice mail with them claiming to be from Apple Support and advising me not to use any of my apple devices for accounting purposes and to call them back at this number.  Apple Spoofing Fake Tech Support Call 1-800-275-2273   This is the voice mail they left  "Security message in regards to your Apple ID our server has detected some suspicious hacker activity on your Apple account please do not use your Apple support until you speak with an Apple support representative please refrain using any financial activity on your devices in order to speak with an Apple support representative right now please press one or else call us back on our toll-free number 1-855-638-5970 I repeat it's 1-855-638-5970 thank you."  You can find more information about this issue from Apple directly: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT204759  Phone scammers have been contacting Apple customers falsely reporting that their iCloud has been compromised.  The data thieves have been disguising themselves as Apple employees in effort to gain access to iCloud users' accounts, users have reported.  If customers have any questions about their account security Apple advises them to call their tech support number 800-275-2273.  #Apple #Scam #Spoofing
